svg.title: net-workings
svg.desc: A handwritten 7 (MNIST reference 23402) beside the shipped CNN's responses to it: four conv 1 maps, four pool 1 maps, eight conv 2 maps, eight pool 2 maps, 32 features, and ten digit probabilities. The cycle clears the drawing, shows the network's response to a blank input, then redraws the digit in 12 steps with a real forward pass at each. MNIST stores no pen order, so the stroke order is synthesized.
